name: prompt-enhancer
description: Enhance Prompt: a button under the prompt that rewrites what you typed, in place, with the files, memories, conversation and skills the task needs. Nothing is sent until you press Enter.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that rewrites the prompt: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus), a full model id, or session for the model this session uses.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks. default lets the model decide; session follows this session's effort.

hindsightSeconds.title: Hindsight time limit (seconds)
hindsightSeconds.description: How long to wait for the Hindsight memory server before going on without it (1 to 60).

soulBank.title: Soul Bank
soulBank.description: The Hindsight bank that holds facts about you and how you like Claude to work.

skillFolders.title: Extra skill folders
skillFolders.description: More folders of skills (each skill a folder with a SKILL.md), separated by commas or semicolons.
